name: explainer-video
description: Short explainer videos made with ManimCE, narrated when the speech plugin is installed and silent otherwise. The produce skill plans the beats, writes one scene script (Text for words, MathTypst for math) whose scene changes follow the narration's word timings, renders it at low quality first, muxes the narration and captions with ffmpeg, and checks every render: ffprobe confirms the streams and durations, a frame is read back after every animation, and overlapping or clipped text fails. A SessionStart hook installs the hash-locked Python packages; the check skill reports whether Python, ManimCE, ffmpeg and ffprobe are ready.
